'''Manus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed in [[Kaas City]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], he used the [[Bounty Brokers Association]] to put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] onto the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Trok]], who tried to recruit [[Exchange]] forces to her service.<ref name="BC" /><ref name="WK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Officer Manus first appeared in game update 2.3 of the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2013]].

He is only accessible through the Bounty Contract Week event quest series of the Empire players in the game on Dromund Kaas.
